charge_port.notes: vw.com: a Volkswagen-approved NACS DC adapter is sold separately for Tesla Superchargers, so the car has a CCS1 DC inlet (VW Canada says the same).

supercharger_access.notes: VW Canada: NACS DC adapter officially available for ID.4 and ID. Buzz, unlocking Tesla NACS partner Superchargers across Canada and the US; Electrek 2025-11-12: access from 2025-11-18, $200 (CAD 304) adapter, MY2026+ include it.

adapters_included.notes: US: US$200 from VW (dealers, parts.vw.com), US$100 rebate for original owners of MY2025 cars (buy before 2026-07-15). Canada: vw.ca says 2025 ID. Buzz owners should ask their dealer; Auto123 reports it is free from the dealership (not confirmed by VW). Sold is the offer that holds in both markets.

wheels.notes: ID. Buzz Pro S Plus 4MOTION 2025: 20x8 read on this Cars.com page (trim shown: Pro S Plus 4MOTION).

heat_pump.notes: Pre-launch article: "A heat pump is standard on all models" (North American ID. Buzz, no year). A pre-launch piece reportedly called it optional like on the Canadian ID.4 (not opened). No VW page found.
